title: Quietly Braised Polish Lamb Stew
description: A winey and pillowy Polish dish featuring lamb shanks, this crowd-pleaser is perfect for special occasions. The leaf-wrap-steam method adds a unique touch to the traditional recipe.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb shanks with salt, black pepper, and dried thyme.
In a large Dutch oven, brown the lamb shanks over medium-high heat, then set them aside.
Soften the chopped onion in the same pot, then add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add the red wine and beef broth to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the lamb shanks to the pot, covering with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
